Here is something fun to help you let go of stress:   

Choose a song that reflects what you need in this moment. Do you need a gentle song to soothe your tired soul or an upbeat song to help you shake some stress out?   

Make a space and move your body to the music. Remember to breathe while you move. Let your breath and the movement go together. 

Even a few minutes of movement can be enough to release stress and lift your mood!
rows.transcript_my_ms_m:
Berikut adalah sesuatu yang menyeronokkan untuk membantu anda melepaskan tekanan:

Pilih sebuah lagu yang sesuai dengan apa yang anda perlukan saat ini. Adakah anda perlukan lagu yang lembut dan perlahan untuk menenangkan jiwa yang letih, atau lagu yang rancak untuk membantu anda rasa bertenaga dan keluarkan rasa tertekan anda?

Cari ruang dan gerakkan tubuh anda mengikut irama. Ingat untuk terus bernafas semasa anda bergerak. Biarkan nafas dan pergerakan anda selari.

Pergerakan selama beberapa minit pun sudah cukup untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menceriakan mood anda!

text_1_facilitator.eng: Today’s parenting skill is about helping your child know how to learn from their mistakes. 💚

text_2.eng:
Learning from our mistakes can help us avoid them in the future. 🌷

It can also help us be more supportive to ourselves and less harsh when things do not go well. 😃

quiz_1_question.eng: True or False: If my child understands their mistake and says sorry, that means I can bring up other mistakes they have made so that they learn.

😔 Your child may be tempted to hide mistakes from you out of fear if they feel unsupported.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 4️⃣ Here are four tips that you can use to help your child learn from their mistakes:

section_1_text.eng:
👂 Create space and time for your child to talk with you about their life. 
💙 If their day was challenging, give space to let them share and listen.
💛 Give them support and show you care. Tell them, "that sounds difficult.”

section_2_text.eng:
💛 Praise your child for the effort they put into their learning even if they did not succeed.
✨ Effort is more important than mastering a specific skill.

section_3_text.eng:
🌱 Mistakes are part of learning. . It’s okay for your child to make them. It helps them learn and grow! 
❓It can be tempting to jump in and fix things for your child, especially when you know the “right” answer. But we have to let them learn how to do it themselves. 
😃 You can talk to your child about their mistakes and allow them to figure out a way to solve their problems and do better next time.

section_4_text.eng:
📖 Try and share your own failures with your child and discuss how they helped you develop and grow. 
✅ This helps your child learn that you do not have to be perfect all the time.
